data.body: Implementation committed at 6780420d70b991238b103663cff1a83ba98e0d20. Comments and docstrings changed only across the 12 allowlisted blocks in three tests/external files. Historical, repeated, emphatic, and ornamental prose was removed while preserving the provider matrix, raw artifacts, deterministic helper ownership, Jira shape contract, workflow routing, terminal-stage contract, and plan-variable guard. Evidence includes PASS results for normalized non-docstring AST and exact directives, the reviewed-block allowlist guard, comment hygiene, scoped Ruff and format checks, seven-test external collection, 15 hermetic consumer tests, pre-commit repository lint and typecheck, diff integrity, and commit-ticket validation. Per operator direction, full make verify is deferred to Gerrit CI. The leaf awaits its independent 12-row receipt and Gerrit availability. It has not been pushed or closed.
